The main takeaway from our work is that
the intrinsic dimension of the metric space, and not its ambient dimension, is the relevant parameter for the design of efficient algorithms.
low-dimensionality, in the form of a bound on the intrinsic dimension, is sufficient to guarantee the existence of a polynomial time approximation algorithm for the TSP.
